source: Curated directory of account-deletion paths for common services. Difficulty taxonomy (easy/medium/hard/impossible) is inspired by justdelete.me (MIT). Links are stable help-center URLs but should be verified before use; services move these pages.

difficulty_legend.medium: Self-service but with a wait, multiple steps, or content that lingers.
difficulty_legend.hard: Hidden flow, long grace period, or a support ticket required.
difficulty_legend.impossible: No deletion path; the best you can do is scrub the data.

services.name: Facebook
services.notes: 30-day grace period; logging back in cancels it. Scrub profile fields first.

services.name: Instagram
services.notes: Deletion is delayed ~30 days before it is permanent.

services.name: Twitter
services.notes: Deactivation, then 30 days to permanent. Also matches x.com.

services.name: X
services.notes: Deactivation, then 30 days to permanent.

services.name: Reddit
services.notes: Account deletes, but your posts and comments remain unless you edit/remove them first. Scrub first.

services.name: TikTok
services.notes: 30-day deactivation window before permanent deletion.

services.name: Snapchat
services.notes: 30-day deactivation before permanent.

services.name: LinkedIn
services.notes: Self-service close-account flow.

services.name: Pinterest
services.notes: Account settings, close account.

services.name: Tumblr
services.notes: Self-service.

services.name: Google
services.notes: Deletes Gmail, YouTube, Drive and more. Export data first.

services.name: YouTube
services.notes: Tied to the Google account; deleting Google deletes YouTube.

services.name: Microsoft
services.notes: 60-day waiting period before closure is final.

services.name: Skype
services.notes: Tied to the Microsoft account; same 60-day wait.

services.name: Apple
services.notes: Request via Data and Privacy; can take up to 7 days to verify.

services.name: Amazon
services.notes: Close account request; may require contacting support.

services.name: Dropbox
services.notes: Self-service.

services.name: GitHub
services.notes: Delete account at the bottom of account settings.

services.name: GitLab
services.notes: Self-service delete account.

services.name: Netflix
services.notes: Cancel membership; account data purged ~10 months after.

services.name: Spotify
services.notes: Self-service via support flow.

services.name: Hulu
services.notes: Cancel and delete from account page.

services.name: WhatsApp
services.notes: In-app: Settings, Account, Delete my account.

services.name: Discord
services.notes: Account stays as 'Deleted User' on messages unless scrubbed.

services.name: Slack
services.notes: Workspace-dependent; admin may need to deactivate.

services.name: Telegram
services.notes: Self-service deactivation page.

services.name: eBay
services.notes: Close-account flow; pending transactions block it.

services.name: Etsy
services.notes: Self-service close account.

services.name: PayPal
services.notes: Balance must be zero; close from account settings.

services.name: Venmo
services.notes: Balance must be zero; close from settings.

services.name: WordPress
services.notes: Self-service account close.

services.name: Medium
services.notes: Delete account at the bottom of settings.

services.name: Substack
services.notes: Delete via account settings; contact support if not visible.

services.name: Quora
services.notes: Content may persist anonymously. Scrub answers first.

services.name: Twitch
services.notes: Disable/delete from security settings.

services.name: Steam
services.notes: Support ticket; loses all purchased games. Scrub profile first.

services.name: Epic Games
services.notes: Delete account request with a waiting period.

services.name: Strava
services.notes: Delete account from profile settings.

services.name: Goodreads
services.notes: Self-service but reviews may persist; scrub first.

services.name: Evernote
services.notes: Self-service from account summary.

services.name: Trello
services.notes: Atlassian account; delete from account preferences.

services.name: Yelp
services.notes: Self-service close account.

services.name: Foursquare
services.notes: Delete from privacy settings.

services.name: Last.fm
services.notes: Delete account from settings.

services.name: Gravatar
services.notes: Tied to WordPress.com/Automattic account.

services.name: Mastodon
services.notes: Instance-dependent; delete from account settings on your home instance.
